info.name: CatCar Platform — Fase 4 Tech Challenge
info.description: Microservices Phase 4 collection. Run folders in order. Set osBaseUrl, billingBaseUrl and executionBaseUrl to the HTTP origins of the three services (from the Aspire dashboard or port-forward), authBaseUrl to the authentication function origin, adminEmail/adminPassword, unique valid synthetic CPFs, an unused plate and SKU, and a controlled test mailbox (Mailpit when running locally). Folder 2 starts the WorkOrderSaga with POST .../work-orders/{id}/budget (202 Accepted). Copy the one-time approval links from the mailbox into Postman Vault as approvalTokenA and approvalTokenB (only the raw token after /approval-links/, without the path) and never export or log them. Folder 3 requires a confirmed Mercado Pago payment for execution; without credentials the payment fails and the saga compensates (ReleaseParts and CancelBudget). Start/complete/fail return 409 when the job is not in the required state. JWTs and ids are held in collection variables for this session; clear them after use.

request.description: Anonymous. Issues the administrative JWT validated by all three services.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const token = pm.response.json().accessToken; pm.test('accessToken returned', () => pm.expect(token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty); pm.collectionVariables.set('adminToken', token); }

request.description: Azure Function. Still reads the customers table of catcar_os (Phase 4 technical debt).

item.name: 2. Open work order A and start saga

request.description: OS service reads the catalog from the Execution service over internal REST.

Creates WorkOrderSaga, publishes catcar.os.request-budget.v1 and schedules ApprovalTimeout (default 72h). No budget id is returned: read it from billing afterwards or copy the approval link from the e-mail (Mailpit).

exec: pm.test('A budget request is already in progress', () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));

item.name: List budgets of work order A

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const budgets = pm.response.json(); if (budgets.length > 0) { pm.collectionVariables.set('budgetIdA', budgets[0].id); pm.test('Budget issued by billing', () => pm.expect(budgets[0].status).to.be.a('string')); } }

request.description: Anonymous; token is single-use and comes from the e-mail link (Mailpit inbox).
Publishes catcar.billing.budget-approved.v1. The saga then reserves parts, requests payment and schedules PaymentTimeout (default 24h).

item.name: List payments of work order A

request.description: Status Pending until Mercado Pago confirms (webhook or 2-minute polling). Without a configured access token the payment is Failed and the saga releases parts and cancels the budget.
Jobs appear once the saga sends StartExecution after PaymentConfirmed.
204 on success; 409 when the job is not Queued (e.g. payment not confirmed yet).
Consumes reserved parts and publishes catcar.execution.execution-completed.v1; the saga marks the work order Completed.

exec: pm.test('Execution completed or not in progress', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([204, 409]));

request.description: catcar.billing.budget-rejected.v1: the saga returns the work order to InDiagnosis without compensations.

body.raw: {"reason":"Demonstrate compensation: refund payment and release parts"}

request.description: Only valid for a job InProgress. catcar.execution.execution-failed.v1 makes the saga publish RefundPayment and ReleaseParts and cancel the work order.

exec: pm.test('Fail registered or not in progress', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([204, 400, 404, 409]));

item.name: Customer B cannot see A progress

exec: pm.test('Different owner receives 404', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql('Work order not found.'); });
